items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of influent screening, grit removal, primary clarification, biological treatment by activated sludge, secondary clarification, disinfection, filtration, and dechlorination.
The second project consists of upgrades to the existing grit removal system...
The second project consists of... retrofitting the existing aeration basins to provide nitrification and denitrification...
The second project consists of... replacing the chlorine disinfection with UV disinfection...
The second project consists of... adding capacity to the existing secondary clarifiers and filters.
